title: [dash] GNMI container memory usage exceeds the limit
author: Yakiv-Huryk
body:
#### Description
While running the sonic-mgmt dash tests, the memory usage for the gnmi container (telemetry process) constantly grows until gets restarted by monit_gnmi:

```
ERR monit[737]: 'container_memory_gnmi' status failed (3) -- [gnmi]: Memory usage (619498700.8 Bytes) is larger than the threshold (419430400 Bytes)!
INFO monit[737]: 'container_memory_gnmi' exec: '/usr/bin/restart_service gnmi'
```

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run sonic-mgmt dash tests
2. Monitor the memory usage for the gnmi docker (docker stats --no-stream  | grep gnmi)
3. Observe that the memory usage gets over the limit defined in the monit_gnmi (419430400) and the container is restarted
